Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as fc9e7fda2bd21c5cc9afca2cef8af0f19b28dc08
Looks like a good idea to me, to clearly separate the entity-manager, fru device, and common code.

This is an entity-manager only file.  Looks like though it gets used by utils.cpp, in a function that is also an EM only function.

fru-device and entity-manager appear to share just a few things in utils, most of utils is for entity-manager.

So at the very least maybe could you move those templateCharReplace functions into expressions.* (or somewhere else) so that the expressions files can be EM only?

Ideally I think EM would get its own util.* files, with then a very small shared one would be left between the two.  Looks like fru-device already has its own fru_utils files.
I will move the utils/expression code in separate changes.
